This is a duplicate of `SubNegMonoid.sub_eq_mul_neg` ensuring that the types unfold better.
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs*

```lean
add_assoc.{u_1} {G : Type u_1} [AddSemigroup G] (a b c : G) : a + b + c = a + (b + c)
```
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs*

```lean
neg_add_cancel_left.{u_1} {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] (a b : G) : -a + (a + b) = b
```
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs*

```lean
dvd_mul_sub_mul.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [NonUnitalCommRing α] {k a b x y : α} (hab : k ∣ a - b) (hxy : k ∣ x - y) :
  k ∣ a * x - b * y
```
